purpose_ko: 1단계 산출물(관측 신뢰도 지도 A, 허용 오차 τ)의 검증 설계 v2: 부분 주입 편향판(참값 기반 마스크 있음), 주입량 ≥ 3τ, 폭의 풀 = 지붕, 잔차 축 = 연직(사양과 같은 축), 두 prior의 정합 이동 반영. 측정(A, MVS, 정상 장면 통계)은 다시 하지 않고 검증 장면과 정의만 바꾼다.

definitions.width_pool: roof (target-building roof faces; L walls are 2.5D-TIN bridging surfaces per the stage-1 order §7, so excluded)
definitions.residual_axis: vertical on roof faces: r_v = r_camZ * |n.d| / |n_z| with the LoD2 face normal; camera-Z reported as reference
definitions.tau_rule: tau = 2.5 * s2 (data width; user decision 2026-09-23); spec kept as error_scale for saturation and injection sizing
definitions.out_of_width: yes AND |r_v - m2_nominal| > tau_nominal (3s and 4tau reported as reference)
definitions.conflict_reference_scene: nominal scene of the same prior

registration.L_source: stage-1 nominal roof vertical m2 = -0.0186 m (block shift consistent over 15 views); ALS raised by +0.0186 m
registration.M_source: author-supplied LoD2Depth arrays minus recovered-CityGML render, roof vertical median = -0.1216 m; recovered mesh raised by +0.1216 m so the clean nominal/biased pair sits in the author's frame

small.note: three small roof faces (annex and corner), ~7% of visible roof pixels; keeps nominal statistics intact for the two-scene check

main.note: main front roof slope, ~92% of visible roof pixels; sensitivity where the prior agrees best

injection.delta_rule: delta >= 3 * tau_prior (L: 8.3x of 0.12 m; M: 3.0x of 1.0 m)
injection.M_step_faces: vertical quads added along the boundary edges of the raised faces so no gap is left
injection.L_method: ALS points inside the XY footprints of the selected faces raised by delta; TIN topology unchanged
